text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh... I really thought I could win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm not being perceptive
enough...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure if I can fix that, things will turn
out
differently. So...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For all of the hard work you've put in for
me, I'm
going to work even harder in
return!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're always looking at me with those
sparkling
eyes of yours—no matter how
things turn out.
choice_data_list: 1着じゃなくても、いいレースだった！
この結果を、次の糧にしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Even if it wasn't first place, that was a great race!
Let's use this result as fuel for next time!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how you'll look at me when I
nab first
place.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll work hard to win next time so I
get to
see that amazing smile.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Next time, I'll run even
faster and
make sure to take first place.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll tackle any training you bring just to
make you
happy! ♪
